facts.text: Evan had a pee accident near some roses after drinking too much with friends the previous day.

evidence.quote: Yesterday I went out with my friends and had a bit too much to drink. I ended up doing something I regret and it involved someone's roses.
I had a pee accident near some roses - can you believe it?

facts.text: Evan apologized for the incident and was fortunate that the person involved was understanding.

evidence.quote: I was so embarrassed when I saw what happened the next morning, so I apologized and luckily they were understanding.

facts.text: Sam expressed concern about the incident and asked if anyone was upset with Evan.

evidence.quote: Uh oh, Evan! That's awkward. Did anyone get mad at you? Are you okay?
